replacement_context.display: Kenneth Walker III is out. NFL.com expects Emmett Johnson to lead. Nate Carter can spell him. Jaydn Ott is questionable with a hamstring injury, so the carry split is uncertain. Emmett Johnson’s posted lines are 16.5 carries (3 books) and 72.5–75.5 rushing yards (5 books). Confirm Jaydn Ott (questionable) at inactives. Kenneth Walker III averaged 19.9 carries per game. The 16.5 threshold suggests a smaller workload with low confidence. Emmett Johnson’s prior high is 8 carries. He averaged 4.27 yards per carry on 26 attempts versus 5.48 on 159 for Kenneth Walker III. The Falcons have allowed 4.42 yards per carry. A lead could favor carries. Passing-down usage matters if trailing. Post-news lines imply about 25 team points. The injury’s incremental win-price effect is unknown.
